query:
The group decided to do a Saturday pub quiz together. Who agreed, and was there anyone whose agreement carried a meaningfully different quality than the others'?

Options:
A. Ravi
B. Cleo
C. Bex
D. Tom
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:29:00) okay group decision: do we do the pub quiz next Saturday as a unit? Tom said Ravi basically carries that team every week and I want to witness it with my own eyes 👀👀
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:33:00) perfect that is settled then! saturday night quiz, everyone in 🎉
[3] (about=Bex, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:10:00) I will. I think I'm going to make it a proper Saturday thing now that there's actually a kitchen worth using.
[4] (about=Cleo, core, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Cleo is not great at quizzes but will come and draw on the answer sheet.
[5] (about=Cleo, said_by=Nadia, profile, t6 @2026-02-01T11:11:00) Nadia notes Cleo got the entire arts and culture round at the pub quiz on her own.
[6] (about=Ravi, core, t6 @2026-02-01T11:11:00) Ravi admits he was wrong about the quiz format being incompatible with the full group; Cleo was useful.
[7] (about=Ravi, said_by=Tom, profile, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Tom says Ravi occasionally carries the quiz team.
agent_answer:
All four agreed: **Ravi (A), Cleo (B), Bex (C), and Tom (D)**.

The agreement that carried a **meaningfully different quality** was **Cleo’s**: she said she isn’t great at quizzes but would come and draw on the answer sheet — i.e., she agreed to attend in a supporting/non-quiz role rather than as a full participant.
